cat << 'PYEOF' | ssh autodl-5090 "cat > /tmp/fig2_script.py"
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import json

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

with open('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/data/cross_generator_results.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

logo = data['leave_one_generator_out']

generators = [
    ('pythia-2.8b', 'Pythia-2.8B'),
    ('pythia-1b', 'Pythia-1B'),
    ('olmo-2-1b', 'OLMo-2-1B'),
    ('qwen3-1.7b', 'Qwen3-1.7B'),
    ('qwen3-0.6b', 'Qwen3-0.6B'),
    ('qwen3-8b', 'Qwen3-8B (8B)'),
]

families = ['Pythia', 'Pythia', 'OLMo', 'Qwen', 'Qwen', 'Qwen']
family_colors = {
    'Pythia': '#0072B2',
    'OLMo': '#009E73',
    'Qwen': '#D55E00',
}

f1_vals = []
ci_lo = []
ci_hi = []
for key, _ in generators:
    g = logo[key]
    f1 = g['macro_f1']
    lo = g['bootstrap_ci']['macro']['ci_lo']
    hi = g['bootstrap_ci']['macro']['ci_hi']
    f1_vals.append(f1)
    ci_lo.append(f1 - lo)
    ci_hi.append(hi - f1)

avg_f1 = logo['average_macro_f1']

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4))

x = np.arange(len(generators))
bar_colors = [family_colors[f] for f in families]
errors = [ci_lo, ci_hi]

bars = ax.bar(x, f1_vals, width=0.6, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white',
              linewidth=0.5, zorder=3)
ax.errorbar(x, f1_vals, yerr=errors, fmt='none', ecolor='#333333',
            capsize=3, capthick=1, linewidth=1, zorder=4)

for i, (val, bar) in enumerate(zip(f1_vals, bars)):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, val + ci_hi[i] + 0.008,
            f'{val:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=8.5, fontweight='medium')

ax.axhline(y=avg_f1, color='#666666', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, zorder=2)
ax.text(len(generators) - 0.5, avg_f1 + 0.005, f'Mean = {avg_f1:.3f}',
        ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9, color='#666666')

# vertical dashed lines between families
ax.axvline(x=1.5, color='#CCCCCC', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax.axvline(x=2.5, color='#CCCCCC', linestyle=':', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels([label for _, label in generators], rotation=15, ha='right')
ax.set_ylabel('Macro-F1')
ax.set_ylim(0.55, 0.95)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, len(generators) - 0.5)

from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#0072B2', label='Pythia'),
    Patch(facecolor='#009E73', label='OLMo'),
    Patch(facecolor='#D55E00', label='Qwen'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower left', framealpha=0.9)

ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(plt.MultipleLocator(0.05))
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, zorder=0)

import os
os.makedirs('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/paper', exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/paper/fig2_logo_performance.pdf')
fig.savefig('/root/gen-depth-fingerprint/figures/paper/fig2_logo_performance.png')
plt.close()
print('Done: fig2_logo_performance.pdf and .png saved.')
